decisions.reason: The DPA management tool fits the firm's stated push into compliance for agencies, and the positive customer feedback on its templates suggests it meets aspirations, so management has no shortfall prompting a search for alternatives.
As the flagship platform shown on the home page and central to the agency-focused direction, it is backed by growing industry turnover and organisational slack, so there is no reason to drop it.

The configurable managed plan sits close to the core hosting business on owned infrastructure, so carrying it costs little and nothing indicates a shortfall against aspirations, though it could be quietly merged into other plans.
